Battle Arena Toshinden Extra Roster

Default: disabled. Enable on the launcher's Mods page.

This package adds Gaia and Sho as optional visible choices on the character
select screen. The normal eight-character roster is unchanged as the bottom row.
Sho is the middle extra row and Gaia is the top extra row. Press Up to cycle
roster to Sho to Gaia to roster, or press Down to cycle roster to Gaia to Sho to
roster. Left and Right only move through the regular roster. Confirm uses the
game's normal selection and match-load path.

Press Select to change costume. Each player's large Gaia/Sho portrait follows
their costume choice, including different costumes in a mirror match. The small
roster cards keep the default portraits.

The visible extra cards and large portraits are supplied by title-specific UI
integration. The portrait textures are generated mod artwork, not extracted or
redistributed game assets; source details are documented in
assets/mods/boss-roster/SOURCE.md.
